11/12/2026
on approach k9 at front of kennel with kennel mate, soft wiggly body. Once kennel door was opened both k9s retreated to back corner of kennel and huddled together. Handler able to easily leash k9 and slowly pick up without issue. K9 was stiff body at first but once being held k9 relaxed and leaned into handler. Handler carried to clinic, placed into pre-op kennel with no issues, k9 came forward with soft and wiggly body, licking handlers hands as kennel door was closed.
11/11/2026
Dog was separated from kennel mate when handlers approached. Alarm barked as handlers entered room, retreated to back of kennel when approached, tense body, growling, came forward when offered treats by hand but was easily startled and retreated again, wouldn't approach with verbal coaxing, handler placed treats in dish and stepped back, dog came forward and ate treats, retreated again when approached. Handler opened kennel door, dog came forward looking past handler, retreated when presented with leash, growling, dodged leash placement, after a few attempts able to place leash with large loop, paced side to side, no longer interested in treats, side eyed when attempting to pet. Handler presented blanket, dog sat up on hind legs pressing body into corner, bared teeth, flailed as handler picked up, settled once in arms, able to carry to small yard with no issues, tense and trembling. Dog ran around yard, soft body and wagging tail when interacting with handlers, front paws on lap soliciting attention, allowed petting all over, jumped on bench and leaned into handler, not interested in treats, appeared wary of surroundings at times, would freeze and scan environment, softened and became wiggly again when handler pet, continued running around yard with kennel mate. Handler picked up leash, leash became tangled with kennel mate's, dog began thrashing as leash was being pulled, once settled handler was able to pick up and carry back to kennel, returned and removed leash by hand.
11/10/2026
Able to separate from kennel mate while using treats to coax then closed kennel divider.  Would start to low growl once separated from kennel mate while lifting & curling front paw up.  Offered more treats in hand then placed a large loop leash onto dog.  Dog would start to pace in kennel while keeping close to back wall of kennel, mouth open wide while panting heavy & being whale eyed.  Handler would place a towel over dog, dog would keep pacing & pawing @ towel.  Handler removed towel & would coax dog forward then placed towel over dog, dog would attempt to jump out & into handlers arms.  Handler placed towel to be draped over arms then attempted to lift dog out of kennel, dog would jump out of handlers arms & land on ground.  Would start to pull back & bite @ leash, able to settle.  Handler would place a towel over dog, dog would start to walk on leash.  Handler would use behavior tote lid to help guide dog to walk, dog would start to pull back & thrash on leash once outside of room.  Handler would attempt to coax dog into behavior tote, dog would dart past handler when closing lid.  Able to coax dog to keep walking to M&G room.  Would explore room with kennel mate while having a relaxed body.  Would approach both handlers & allow all petting without issues.  Gently took treats.  Would appear to know "SIT" for treats.  Would start to pace along room walls with kennel mate, able to call dog over & pet throughout body while kennel mate would continue to pace in room.  Assistant handler would kneel down & was able to slowly pick up dog by hands then placed into handlers lap.  Slowly picked up dog once in lap & carried back to kennel while allowing petting.  Removed leash by hand then quickly closed kennel gate once back in kennel.
11/9/2026
No issues separating from kennel mate. Low growling with stiff body, wide eyed, pacing and circling in kennel, no interest in treats offered or tossed near. Whale eye and stiff bodied when placing leash, would low growl if attempting to pet, sniffed treat offered but did not eat. Attempted to drape towel over but dog would become erratic, thrashing and low growling out of towel. Applied bite gloves and let dog settle, attempted to drape towel over once more and when lifting dog would become frantic, biting at towel, thrashing and airsnapping towards handlers hand when head came out of towel. Dog would continue to pace in kennel and low growl when attempting to recover leash, leash fell off on own. Due to rising levels of FAS and safety concerns unable to remove from kennel.
11/3/2026
Tense body, wide eyed, pulls back and thrashes when leash pressure is applied. Allowed hnadler to blanket wrap, allowed restraint for vaccines. Carried to kennel.

sections.evaluation_comments:
11/12/2026
Dog was closed to back half of kennel during AM cleaning.  Would start to jump up while demand barking.  Offered treats then inserted leash into kennel while dog would be eating.  Started to jump up during leash placement while biting @ leash.  Walked with a hard pull on leash to PY, stopping to turn biting @ leash as well thrashing while pulling back & hitting white dividing barrier, able to redirect & keep walking forward verbally.  Once in PY, dog would start to pace along fence line, stopping to look up towards top of fence line then pawing @ bottom of fence.  Approached doors of fence, digging @ green turf & pushing muzzle against fence.  Able to call dog over while tossing treats.  Dog would come to eat treats then returned to pacing.  Would start to pace in circles around handler as handler was sitting on chair, would approach handler, allowing petting then started to make a low growl, handler would remove hands, dog would return to pacing in circles then along fence line again.  Would start to jump up while bounding off against gate then hitting nose on latch of gates.  Able to call dog over, scatter treats then picked up leash.  Attached a clip leash without issues & walked back to kennel.  Dog would start to pull back & thrash body when getting closer to kennel.  Opened kennel gate, dog would start to bite @ leash while pawing & thrashing body.  Scattered a handful of treats into kennel, dog would enter.  Closed gate & started to remove leash with use of clip leash, dog would start to push out of gate, scattered more treats in kennel then able to continue to remove leash with clip leash.
11/11/2026
Greeted handler at front of kennel with soft body, wagging tail, jumping up onto kennel door with some heavy wide mouth panting and wide eyed, some whining. Jumped up onto kennel door when presenting leash, settled and allowed for easy leash placement, some pulling to "I" yard but no interest in dogs in passing. In yard dog would begin pacing around yard immediately, heavy panting, wide eyed, erratic, jumped up onto handler sitting on chair and solicited attentions allowing petting all over, attempts to lick handlers face, no issues directing off, accepted treats gently and knows "SIT" but once pets are done continued pacing around yard. Some intense sniffs around yard fence, continued to jump up onto handler whenever near handler as handler sat in chair. Came to handler when called over to leave, when retrieving leash and opening play yard exit dog pulled back on leash hard, tense bodied, sat and froze in place, became soft and wiggly when handler knelt down and able to coax thru, some pulling on walk back to kennel, erratic and jumping onto fence. Would not enter building towards kennel, pulled back on leash and froze, would come to handler as handler knelt down with wagging tail and soft body but would not pass threshold, used slight leash pressure to guide dog thru, became erratic walking back to kennel jumping onto divider wall, hesitant and would not enter kennel until handler stepped into kennel and dog followed, able to remove leash by hand with no issues.
11/9/2026
Soft bodied, tail wagging, soliciting attentions with handler thru kennel door, demand barked when not focused on dog. Needs full evaluation based on recent intake note.
11/8/2026
Easy leashing, walking into Triage. Allowed all petting. Walked to dog building, pancaking at door. Carried throuh dog ward
11/5/2026
Social / Approaches easily, Easy / Cooperative, Took to play yard, Easy / Loose leash, Low energy, Social / Affiliative, Affectionate towards handler, Accepted pets, Easy return, Took treats gently, Demonstrated sit, Walked well on walk path, slight pull on leash. Checked in with handler during walk. Did not react to dogs in kennels.
10/25/2026
Greeted handler at front of kennel with soft neutral body, soft tail wag, mouthy with treats offered. Easy leash placement at front of kennel, walked with some pulling to play yard, zig zag walking pattern, sniffed dogs in passing quickly with neutral soft body. In yard dog would accept pets on back while placing leash stopper, began exploring to go potty before approaching handler for attentions, allowed petting all over, accepted treats gently but at times can be mouthy, started to nudge treat pouch for treats, easy to direct away with treats or verbally, jumps up onto handler while sitting on bench for attentions and treats, no issues directing off. Would follow handler around yard with neutral soft body and neutral tail, knows "SIT". Easy return to kennel, froze at kennel door but able to be guided into kennel with no issues. Allowed handler to remove leash by hand.
10/24/2026
Closed inside for AM cleaning. Dog approached handler with soft body and wagging tail, took treats. Easy to leash, moderate pull to yard, ignored kenneled dogs in passing. Affiliative with handler, soft body and wagging tail, sat for treats, offered from palm of hand due to being grabby. Explored yard, nose to ground, body relaxed and neutral, returned to handler soliciting more attention and treats, continued exploring, allowed handler to approach and pet, able to pick up leash, hesitant to enter building, ears pinned, scanning surroundings, able to guide into building with mild leash pressure and verbal coaxing, startled by reactive dogs when walking through building, alarm barked when seeing staff member but quickly settled and continued following handler, hesitant to enter kennel, handler stepped in, dog followed, able to exit and remove leash by hand.
10/23/2026
Dog was closed outside for cleaning, standing with neutral body language, tail down. Accepted treats, pushed snout against gate but otherwise easy to leash. Walked with slight tense body, head low, occasionally tried to pull in opposite direction but was easy to redirect with light leash pressure and verbal coaxing. In yard, dog explored with tail down, nose to ground. Handler gave dog some space. Dog eventually began approaching handler, would stand beside them while watching surroundings. A little grabby with treats but still able to be given by hand. Handler sat on bench, dog approached, nudged snout into hands, allowed all petting. Dog watched other dogs pass outside of yard, furrowed brown, ears forward, followed along fence line. Handler called to dog, dog returned to handler, allowed more petting. Moderate pull on return. Dog would not enter kennel, face remained neutral but dog would pull back on leash. Handler began giving treats to get dog's attention, then tossed jackpot into kennel. Dog slowly stepped in, then turned and pushed snout against gate. Leash removed via clip lead.
10/20/2026
K9 greeted 2nd handler by jumping up and allowed handler to walk into intake room, once in intake room K9 became tense, started to lip lick, and duck away from handling toward the head, used muzzle wrap for vaccines due to K9 behavior, K9 did back away from handling the longer K9 was in intake room. Walked to kennel without concerns until reach inside kennel became alert, felt low growling, piloerection, entered kennel and used clip leash to remove leash

sections.evaluation_comments:
11/12/2026
Dog was lying down in front half of kennel, handler went to open kennel gate, dog would quickly retreat to outside half of kennel, slowly closed divider.  Dog would be lying down while being whale eyed, panting heavy, avoiding eye contact, ears pinned back.  Unable to coax dog forward with treats or verbal coaxing.  Stepped into kennel with a wide loop leash, walked with moderate pull on leash while having tail fully tucked under body, walking in a zig zag pattern, ears pinned back, head lowered & panting heavy.  Once in main PY, dog would start to pace along fence line then lay down near gate.  Handler approached dog, dog would turn head to look away while looking away, tensing body & lowering head.  Walked dog to M&G room, dog would walk with a moderate pull on leash in a zig zag pattern.  Once in room, dog would stand facing wall away from handler with tail fully tucked under body, back legs spread wide apart, mouth wide open, spatula tongue, panting heavy, ears pinned back & trembling body.  Would not relax posture while handler would speak softly.  After a few minutes, handler approached dog & picked up leash.  Would do intense skin crawling when being touched.  Walked back to kennel with tail fully tucked under, ears pinned & still panting heavily with mouth wide opened.  Quickly entered into kennel & retreated to divider wall.  Would not come forward with verbal coaxing or treats.  Slowly entered into kennel & removed leash by hand without issues.
11/11/2026
Closed in for AM cleaning. Dog laying down in back of kennel; trembling; whale eyed; furrowed brow; ears back; tossed treats; not interested; handler was able to place large loop over; leashed; dog retreated towards back of kennel; handler verbally coaxed; used light leash guidance; exited; body low to ground; ears back; tail tucked; walked behind handler; some zig zag.
